prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create ONE portrait low-fidelity UX sketch, 3:4 aspect, focused Detail Pesanan component for a shoelaundry cashier mobile app at a 390x520 logical size. No device bezel/OS, no branding, no design-option number or extra headings. White background; black and gray only; lightly handdrawn rectangular borders with very readable large printed Indonesian labels. Not a collage.
Reference image 1 is research context of existing payment record, not a visual style/layout target. Do not copy blue or green/orange colors, nor Rp57.000. Context is PSN-015, Bank Transfer, Rp150.000.
Distinct concept: comparison table, two equal columns under title. Header 'Detail Pesanan', 'PSN-015 | Bank Transfer'. A narrow readable strip 'Pembayaran tercatat' with helper 'Belum memastikan dana masuk'. Then a simple two-column comparison card, column headings 'Pesanan' and 'Bukti'. Exactly three aligned rows: both columns 'PSN-015'; both columns 'Rp150.000'; left 'Deep cleaning' and right 'Bukti pelanggan'. Small outline thumbnail inside right column with 'Lihat bukti', no fake bank logo. Keep values large, layout breathe. Below the comparison card a separate full-width result panel 'Pemeriksaan', then 'Pemeriksa: Owner', large 'Menunggu hasil', 'Hasil belum tersedia', and clear outlined button 'Lihat permintaan'. At bottom a light gray visibly INACTIVE 'Teruskan' button with reason 'Hasil memadai belum tersedia'. Very small 'Data ilustrasi' at foot. The composition must prominently emphasize side-by-side comparison, unlike accordion or stepper. No field for admin to approve bank receipt. No automatic bank integration, no ETA, no result shown while waiting.
qa: Inspected inline; labels readable and waiting explicit, inactive Teruskan. Right Kode Pesanan is contextual relation label, not a claim bank proof itself carries order ID. On small mobile two columns remain density risk noted in concept_briefs.
